decisions.reason: The flagship GIS platform sits at the core of the firm's established geospatial knowledge, and its own R&D lets the firm learn from market results and keep developing it.
Mobile field data capture is close to the firm's established offer and had its own page in both observed years, so the firm can interpret results and improve it with its in-house R&D.

The search extension builds directly on the firm's web map platform and was actively versioned in 2019, which shows continued assimilation and development, although similar small plugins were dropped earlier.
